source: SCI P398 (2013), section 4 Step 1 p53; Example D.1 pp129-134 (PDF137-142)
field: Force distribution only. Source UK factors do not enter these mechanical calculations.
notes: Source axial compression is positive. API actions on the left member use Fx<0 for compression, Fy<0 downward, Mz<0 for top flange tension.
p133 prints 16.6kNm for 150kN*(0.070+0.085/2)m. Exact multiplication gives 16.875kNm. The published value is retained below, never used to calibrate code.
p133 rounds the bolt polar moment 68437.5mm2 to 68400mm2. Ratios of web area/inertia are also rounded in the publication.
Independent calculations use 35-digit decimal arithmetic from stated dimensions, not production-code output. No source capacity is inferred from Balanced.
